book.name: Luka
book.title: Orooka o lebo ka Luka wele

content: A ale ka Yesoa begeshe be Bilatus ka Hiridus
Pate aromo kane gwarnang nane ere aane ale ka Yeso a begeshe be Ogomo Bilatus.

Nane bore o anza kai angmǝ na, “Te mana karomo kaana aka wilǝrǝzǝ aromo aro, aka beya ne na tana ne nya Ogomo ogong o Roma Kaisar emate makeke ne kanza aka beya okpwe kai na, kaya Ondooka Ashili a zake na ogomo.”
Na Ogomo Bilatus pirkǝ Yeso na, “Boa ogomo maYahuda na?” Na Yeso kabare na, “Ba bekaa kap.”
Na Ogomo Bilatus wa bele ana magame ma Ashili ma moole ka leguki le aromo na, “Mi anta ma cǝ epa e buru eka eyang meke me aza karomo kaana ne.”
Nane nyane epa eka wa bekaa ne lya izi ko beyana, “O baala kai wa ara anyong aromo a nyimi makeke maYahuda. Ka bore apeng Galili, naka deya ara kaana.”
Ka o kona nyimi, na Ogomo Bilatus pirkǝ na kai karomo ka makeke ma Galili kai na.
Nangka wa rose o bena Yeso ka suri a araaka Ogomo Hiridus waya togomo ne, na wa turki ne ara a Ogomo Hiridus me, a were name wai Ogomo Hiridus waya apeng Urushalima.
Nangka Ogomo Hiridus wa laka Yeso, na wa kone o leba a cak, o bena wa rabo ka o yeme o laka Yeso me, wa koneze oroka o bekaana, ka ezeze epa eka e kala begeshe ba aromo, na wa ya yeme o laka ebelo e.
Na Ogomo Hiridus pirkǝ Yeso aza angmǝ cak, na Yeso kata kabare ka eyapa ne.
Ana magame ma Ashili ma moole ka ana o baala angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa nane itǝ arame aane beya ngmǝ ka o caro anyong aza Yeso ka o beyana, ka eza mapa ma buru.
Na ana Ogomo Hiridus ka ana o tesa geza a moole a wai, ne zeele kai kanza ane beye kai angmǝ a buru. Nane amba kai o dibi o togomo ane kuriyǝ kai ara Ogomo Bilatus.
A lengme lennamea Ogomo Bilatus ka Ogomo Hiridus ne itǝ ejaa, o bora neta ne ciisǝ a cammo a tokpwe tone ne.
Na Ogomo Bilatus rare andaano maYahuda, neya, ana magame ma Ashili ma moole, ka anate andaasau ka o dangare aromo a pate,

na wa bekaa ne na, “E deya ka karomo kaana aza o bena e beeze na ka wilǝrǝzǝ aromo kane nare o cikǝ o cammo. Ma pirǝ kai a begeshe be ying adorana ang cǝ o dera gaashe a kai, nanta ma cǝ epa e buru eka ma era ang meke aza kai ne.
Ogomo Hiridus ma wata wa cǝ epa e buru aza kai ne, waya wa ote na wa turki kai ara ong, karomo kaana kata ka ya eyapa o bare ka wong kai ne.
Aza nyimi, eyang ote ka ola kai ang pere kai.”
A Ogomo Bilatus waye ka o pere oromo yende ka a pate, a were o gwarnang o rintǝ o dera o wonga ayana o bora maYahuda a Masar omea ne mena ka o bosaza me.
Na aromo me ka le ngmelo le yende, beke a jǝng na, “Ale na ka karomo kaana ka e wong kai, a pere ro Barabas.”
A Barabas a pate wai ara ana o eza epa e buru aza o bekaana wa gereze bete a nyimi apengme, kanza azaa o wonga oromo.
Ogomo Bilatus waya yeme o perea Yeso, na wa kang bosa ne.
Nane lya izi ka o arsaza a ngmelo na, “A wong kai azaa uti o gendare. A wong kai azaa uti o gendare.”
Ka taaro naname ka Ogomo Bilatus beke angmǝ aane na, “Eya e? Karomo kaana kaya eya e buru? Me anta ma cǝ epa e buru ba kai ka e bare o wongnga kai ne. Eyang ote ka ole kai ang pere kai.”
Na aromo me ne ara lengmelo ajǝng o bena soona a wong kai aza uti o gendare.
Na Ogomo Bilatus kabare ka epa eka neya yeme me.
Nawa pere oromo oka a pate a nyimi akwilǝ ana o eza epa e buru, kawa gereze bete a nyimi apeng a wa kang wongnga ondo, waiya ne bose na a pere wai, a wa nya Yeso nangka neya yeme me kane wong kai.
A gendare Yeso aza o uti
Nangka ana o tesa geza a moole neya ale ka Yeso, nane gwarnang ka Siman oromo o Siyarin a waya lyǝ apeng, nane meke wai ane ana wai uti o gendara aromo, a wa tare Yeso a dimǝ.
A aromo a cake tare kai, ka andaye yende kane kone egonegone ane kang ruuzi aza o ziyǝ ka Yeso ka ya kona me.
Na Yeso ringgarnu naka bekaa ne na, “Andaye o Urushalima, tana e ruuzi aza ong ne, ruuzi na aza tokpwe to ying ka ayana aying.
A were aya deya amea eyo bekaana, ‘Ondo kona o leba andaye amea neta ne tukǝ ngmenga ne, a bangi amea a ta ngmengzaza ne kanza a maane mame a ta a tukǝ o asaka mai ne.’
A were name

content.text: “ ‘Neyo beka a mayara na, “Oko na aza aro.”

content: Aka beke angmǝ a gerpo na, “Aromo ne eza mapa maana a were aka uti tata o nyaza, wayo itǝ nannia uti me wa waka?”
Aromo leere, ana o eza epa e buru a ale ka ne legwa ka Yeso adorana a wong ne.
Nangka ne dukǝ araaka beya ai na, “Ara macako ma okpwe” arakaname a gendare Yeso uti ne. Ka ana o eza epa e buru name, ondo o ara ore, a ondo o ara o guri.
Na Yeso bekaana, “Ate, kwizǝ epa e buru ana o nyana ong, o bena neta rosa na mana mi ne.” Ane eke madibi ma kai a tera one nane laka mana waya jeka.
Aromo ne itǝ ane gonte, anda gong ane nane zeele kai, ane beya na, “Ka boza na ondo, aka boze okpwe kai ka ya kaaya ondo boza oka Ashili a zake.”
Ana o tesa a geza a moole ne de nane zeele kai. Ane niyi kai manyi ma marara ma yana inabi,
ane beya kai na, “Boa baya ogomo maYahuda, boza okpwe o.”
Aza ka okpwe kai a wele na, “KANDO KAANA KAYA OGOMO MAYAHUDA.”
Ondo a nyimi ana o eza epa e buru me ka a gendare ne ka Yeso na wa zeele kai, a wa bekaana, “Boa baya Ondooka Ashili a zake, boza okpwe o ka ro.”
A ondo eza epa e buru o leere me wa zurki a wai na, “O kone boome ba Ashili sang, bo ka a gendare uti ona ka kai?
Ro teya eesa o poba oka wa gwara ka ro, kai ka ta ka ya epa e buru ne.”
A wa bekaana, “Yeso rintǝng a were aka ba lyǝ a nyimi togomo to.”
Na Yeso kabare wai na, “Eyang bele o maganggang, o ngmeengme na oyo cikǝ ka mi ara a lebo ang aza shili.”
O gbwǝ o Yeso
A tera letereme na ye maring a kuruwǝ a makeke mame, nama dukǝ o gendarono ongme,
na ongme wata nya masanto ne.
Na Yeso ka ara lengmelo a jǝng naka bekaana, “Ate, ma nyau ebeene eng a nyimi taara to.” Ka o bekaa nyimi, aka windi ebeene kai o mare a ka gbwi.
Nangka ondo tesa a geza a moole o gong a Roma wa laka epa eka ka ya, na wa saba Ashili a wa bekaana, “Dongdong karomo kaana kando ka o dera madinǝ kai.”
Na aromo aka neya gonta epa eka aya eza me arame, nane kuri akwilǝ ka o ola begeshe be ne a nyimi o kona o buru.
Pate aromo aka ne rose Yeso ka andaye amea ne tare kai a sura a makeke ma Galili, nane itǝ a macangcang ane gonte epa eka eya ale.
O taasa Yeso
Ondo wa zene ka a beya wai na Yusupu, ka waye a nyimi andaano maYahuda, oromo me waye ka edang, a wa kone boome ba Ashili,
wata wa kabare ka epa eka andaano maYahuda ne eze ne. Wa de a wa suri a makeke ma Yahudiya apeng a Arimatiya a waya za o enda togomo to Ashili.
Nawa ale ba Ogomo Bilatus na wa bose wai na wa nya wai lepung le Yeso.
Nawa jipǝrǝ lepung le kai, a wa pate le ka betu a wa ote le ocau oka a coo o cale omea a ta a tukǝ o eza matasokong a wai ne.
Lengme leme lo babarono adorana a lyǝ a lengme lo teeseke ka o bosa Ashili maYahuda.
Andaye amea ne tare Yeso a surǝ a makeke ma Galili, nane ale ka Yusupu adorana ne laka araaka o cau me wa zene ka nangka a eke lepung le Yeso leme.
Nane suri akwilǝ, ane babare manao ma o waze o lebo. A lengme lo teseke nane teseke, nane teseke nangka angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa a bekaana a eze.

footnotes.text: nangka Hoseya ondo o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili wa wele. Hos 10:8.
Yeso kaya beya na, “Aromo neeya gǝǝzǝ ong nanna anta eza epa e buru ne, neyo gǝǝzǝ ying o kala a ong aza o bena e eza epa e buru.”
